body.name: Rhat
body.def: For \(i\in I_\ell\), the bracket numerator of \(\widehat R_i\) uses \(\widehat p^{-\ell}\) and \(\widehat m^{-\ell}\), while its final target-share denominator is the global empirical share \(\widehat\pi_{g,1}=n^{-1}\sum_i\mathbf 1\{G_i=g,S_i=1\}\).
body.role: validation-fold score with global ratio denominator
